blocks.text: More than 3,400 local and overseas employment opportunities were brought closer to jobseekers as government agencies, private employers, and partner organizations joined forces to deliver accessible employment services to residents during the first-ever Trabaho at Katarungan Caravan in Caloocan City. Held on November 21, 2026, at the Caloocan City Sports Complex, the initiative served 1,708 residents from Caloocan and Metro Manila, providing direct access to job opportunities, pre-employment requirements, labor assistance, and other essential government services.
